description: Saves the owner's own mobile number on the business record (the number Kai texts whenever it takes a call for the owner) so Kai can ring it first and so activation/forwarding follow-ups can reach a human — connecting a number alone does not prove the owner can be reached. In the acquisition flow this step comes before search_available_numbers and buy_number (#2086). US numbers only; normalized to E.164 and rejected if it cannot be validated as a US mobile/landline number. When ring_first is true (default), also configures ring-first routing so calls hit this cell before overflowing to the secretary — the same path used at signup. declined=true, in place of owner_phone, records a caller who declines to give a number as an inquiry: a KaiCalls lead, with no provisioned business or number.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

contact_email.description: Only used with declined=true: an email for the inquiry record, if given.

contact_name.description: Only used with declined=true: the caller name, for the inquiry record.

declined.description: True (in place of owner_phone) when the caller will not give a reachable number. Records the business as an inquiry lead instead of a provisioned number.

owner_phone.description: The owner's own mobile number, US format (e.g. (908) 555-1234 or +19085551234). Required unless declined is true.

ring_first.description: When true (default), ring this number first and overflow to the secretary. When false, only saves the number.

name: set_owner_phone
title: Set Owner Phone
